question: What is the percentage of carcinogenic molecules in triple type bonds?
evidence: label = '+' mean molecules are carcinogenic; triple bond refers to bond_type = '#'; percentage = DIVIDE(SUM(bond_type = '#') * 100, COUNT(bond_id)) as percent where label = '+'
clarification: Count every row, including repeated molecule_id values.
gold: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#'
gold0: SELECT CAST(COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN T2.label = '+' THEN T2.molecule_id ELSE NULL END) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(DISTINCT T2.molecule_id) FROM atom AS T1 INNER JOIN molecule AS T2 ON T1.molecule_id = T2.molecule_id INNER JOIN bond AS T3 ON T2.molecule_id = T3.molecule_id WHERE T3.bond_type = '#'

d.request: Among bond rows for carcinogenic molecules (label `+`), what percentage are triple bonds (bond_type `#`), counting every row even when `molecule_id` repeats?
d.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS percentage FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';

b.request: Among bonds belonging to carcinogenic molecules (`label = '+'`), what percentage of bond rows have `bond_type = '#'`, counting every bond row even when molecule IDs repeat?
b.sql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN b.bond_type = '#' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS percentage FROM bond AS b JOIN molecule AS m ON b.molecule_id = m.molecule_id WHERE m.label = '+';
